summary: Add the approved governance contracts and validation scripts without widening the story scope.

decisions.decision: Vendored schema copies in the repository are the minimal, reversible solution.
decisions.rationale: This satisfies the requirement to add the approved schemas while keeping the story narrow and deterministic.
alternatives: Generated sync from an external source
Using a local non-versioned generated folder

risks.description: Schema drift between upstream and vendored copies
risks.mitigation: Review the source schema before updates and keep the vendored copy synchronized intentionally.

testStrategy: Validate repository config against the real commands
Validate representative valid and invalid contract fixtures
rollout: Manual repository change with local validation before review.
rollback: Remove the added schema files, validation scripts, and delivery config while preserving the rest of the repo.
